metric_definitions.missing_fact_precision: TP / (TP + FP) over semantic (case_id, fact_key) missing-field labels.
metric_definitions.missing_fact_recall: TP / (TP + FN) over semantic (case_id, fact_key) missing-field labels.
metric_definitions.duplicate_question_rate: Questions whose fact_key repeats earlier in the same round or appears in provided previous-request history, divided by emitted questions.
metric_definitions.critical_fact_leakage: Cases labelled with a critical gap but marked substantive_ready=true, divided by cases labelled with a critical gap. Detector errors remain fail-closed and never count as ready.

threshold_rationale: Conservative exact targets were chosen before the first final run because the evaluated registry, detector, clarification templates, labels, and runner are deterministic offline contracts.
threshold_change_policy: Do not lower or otherwise change thresholds after observing Week-3 development metrics. Any future change requires a new versioned specification and documented rationale.
